item.title: LogicGrid 11.2.0
item.description:
New

  • Focus mode. A new draw mode that lights up just the bar your cursor is in, plus one bar on each side. Press Control Option K to cycle to it, or pick it in Settings.
  • Secondary ruler support. If you work with Logic's secondary ruler, open Settings and choose your ruler setup: Music bars, Timecode, or Secondary Ruler.

Fixes

  • Lower CPU use while the grid is muted.
  • More stable when switching between project alternatives.
  • Removed a brief grid flicker that could show up during quick window or screen changes.
